summary: Promote the BrewMind companion contract from a 'working reference' to canonical governed state under the workflows surface.
rationale: docs/companion-agent/brewmind-companion-contract.md is the behavioral backbone for all BrewMind work — it defines abstention rules, evidence tiers, the approval ceremony, lane system, and humane purpose. CLAUDE.md references it as '(working reference — not yet canonical governed state)'. A prior proposal (prop-20260414-001) intended to canonicalize it but was never completed. Until this is promoted, the most consequential behavioral contract can drift without triggering the governance gate. The workflows surface (users/cici/governed-state/workflows/) already has a brewmind-companion-contract-ref.json stub that points to the working doc — upgrading it to canonical makes the reference authoritative and prevents silent rewrites.
proposed_diff_summary: 1. Copy docs/companion-agent/brewmind-companion-contract.md to users/cici/governed-state/workflows/companion-contract.md and mark it canonical. 2. Update users/cici/governed-state/workflows/brewmind-companion-contract-ref.json to reference the canonical path instead of docs/. 3. Update CLAUDE.md to remove '(working reference — not yet canonical governed state)' from the companion contract link and replace with '(canonical governed state — workflows surface)'. 4. Update surface-map.json to add companion-contract.md to the workflows canonical_files list.
